name: Android Scripts & Build

on:
  push:
    branches: [ master, main ]
    paths:
      - 'scripts/**'
      - '.github/workflows/scripts-android.yml'
      - 'BUILDING.md'
  pull_request:
    branches: [ master, main ]
    paths:
      - 'scripts/**'
      - '.github/workflows/scripts-android.yml'
      - 'BUILDING.md'

jobs:
  lint-scripts:
    name: Lint Shell Scripts
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Run ShellCheck and shfmt
        uses: luizm/action-sh-checker@883217215b11c1fabbf00eb1a9a041f62d74c744
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          SH_CHECKER_EXCLUDE: "vendor|node_modules"
          SH_CHECKER_COMMENT: true
          SH_CHECKER_ONLY_DIFF: true

  build-android-port:
    name: Build Android Port
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up JDK 8
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: '8'
          distribution: 'temurin'
          cache: maven

      - name: Setup Android SDK
        uses: android-actions/setup-android@v3
        with:
          cmdline-tools-version: "9477386"
          accept-android-sdk-licenses: true

      - name: Setup Android NDK
        uses: nttld/setup-ndk@v1
        with:
          ndk-version: r21e
          add-to-path: true

      - name: Setup Workspace
        run: |
          chmod +x scripts/setup-workspace.sh
          ./scripts/setup-workspace.sh -q -DskipTests -Darchetype.test.skip=true

      - name: Build Android Port
        run: |
          source tools/env.sh
          chmod +x scripts/build-android-port.sh
          ./scripts/build-android-port.sh -q -DskipTests -Dmaven.javadoc.skip=true

  build-android-port-macos:
    name: Build Android Port (macOS)
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up JDK 8 (Intel for Apple Silicon compatibility)
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: '8'
          distribution: 'temurin'
          architecture: x64
          cache: maven

      - name: Setup Android SDK
        uses: android-actions/setup-android@v3
        with:
          cmdline-tools-version: "9477386"
          accept-android-sdk-licenses: true

      - name: Setup Android NDK
        uses: nttld/setup-ndk@v1
        with:
          ndk-version: r21e
          add-to-path: true

      - name: Setup Workspace
        run: |
          chmod +x scripts/setup-workspace.sh
          ./scripts/setup-workspace.sh -q -DskipTests -Darchetype.test.skip=true

      - name: Build Android Port
        run: |
          source tools/env.sh
          chmod +x scripts/build-android-port.sh
          ./scripts/build-android-port.sh -q -DskipTests -Dmaven.javadoc.skip=true
